title: 第2776章 进入天尊古殿第2775章 生死殿主的怪异举动
content_zh:
盖藏神王立在黑暗虚空之中，血翼遮天蔽日，闪耀着无穷血光，沉声提醒其他异族神王，道：“如果本座没有猜错，想必应该是生死天尊当年的生命通天树与死亡天斧。虽说跟真正天尊古兵‘天尊生死轮’有一定差距，不过也绝对是地神兵层次，更是蕴含着生死天尊的两大至尊天道之力，不容小瞧。”
阿莫耶女皇眼神冰冷，望着源源不断袭来的苍龙攻势，嘴角勾起一抹冷冽的弧度：“原来那位生死殿主故意退让，是早已布下了这般杀局。”
大袖一拂，三十六颗巨大的星辰母巢悬浮在虚空之中，光芒璀璨，无数虫族战士从母巢中喷涌而出，密密麻麻铺满整片天空，朝着天尊古殿疯狂冲锋。
其中不乏众多神灵层次，也有大神层次。
更为可怕的是，若隐若现间，有神王层次的出现，可怕无边。
“动手吧，也就生命通天树以及死亡天斧阻拦而已。”
长青神皇、洞虚星主、盖藏神王再度出手。
死亡天斧和生命通天树再度全力发难，两大顶尖地神兵的神威浩瀚无边，每一次劈杀、每一次缠绕，都拥有堪比神王的恐怖战力。
一时之间，强如四位神王被牵制，短时间内根本无法靠近天尊古殿半步。
战局僵持之际，无幽神王趁机动身，闪电般地冲向天尊古殿。
生命通天树与死亡天斧正在被四大异族神王牵制之间，毫无疑问是进入天尊古殿的大好机会。
唰！
无声无息，生死殿主的身形骤然闪现，祭出天尊生死轮，以镇压万古的轮回之力倾泻而下，精准笼罩住无幽神王。
无幽神王骤然色变：“生死殿主，你竟敢阴本座？”
但来不及了。
生死殿主太快了，而且还持掌着天尊生死轮这等天尊古兵，可谓是同阶无敌手。
一声沉闷的巨响炸开。
无幽神王再度炸开。
天尊生死轮释放出无与伦比的生死天光，生死太极图如同磨灭万古的轮盘，每一次转动，都崩碎无幽神王大量的神魂。
无幽神王不可谓不够强，可跟生死殿主终究是无法相提并论，更何况是掌握了天尊古兵的情况下，神尊都要忌惮无比。

“诸位，还请出手救我，否则我殒落了，你等也将会被逐一击破！”
无幽神王传出了求救声。
正常情况下，别说是神王，就算是神尊想要杀死神王都千难万难。
但生死殿主复苏同属性的天尊生死轮这等天尊古兵，炼杀神王根本不成问题。
四大族神王无不是变色，虽然因为无幽神王方才想要捷足先登很是不爽，可不爽归不爽，终究不能眼睁睁地看着他被天尊生死轮所炼杀。
正如其所言，一旦无幽神王被炼杀，接下来就是他们了。
轰轰轰轰！
当即，四大族神王放弃与生死二神兵的碰撞，转而施展神王大术，攻击向生死殿主，营救无幽神王。
最起码不能让生死殿主真的杀死无幽神王，否则后果不堪设想。
无奈之下，生死殿主只能放弃继续炼杀无幽神王，以天尊生死轮抵挡，化解攻击。
content_en:
The God King Gaizang stood in the dark void, his blood wings covering the sky and the sun, shining with infinite blood light. He reminded the other alien God Kings in a deep voice, saying: "If I guessed correctly, they must be the Tree of Life and the Heavenly Ax of Death that were used by the Heavenly Lord of Life and Death. Although there is a certain gap between them and the real ancient weapon of the Heavenly Lord, the 'Tianzun Wheel of Life and Death', it is definitely at the level of the Earth God Weapon, and it contains the two supreme powers of the Heavenly Way of the Heavenly Lord of Life and Death, which should not be underestimated."
Queen Amoye's eyes were cold as she looked at the incoming Canglong offensive. A cold arc appeared at the corner of her mouth: "It turns out that the master of the Palace of Life and Death deliberately backed down and had already laid out such a killing plan."
With a flick of his sleeves, thirty-six huge star broods were suspended in the void, shining brightly. Countless Zerg warriors spewed out from the broods, densely covering the entire sky, and charged crazily towards the Tianzun Ancient Palace.
There are many levels of gods, as well as levels of great gods.
What is even more frightening is that there is a god-king level appearing looming, which is extremely terrifying.
"Let's do it, only the Tree of Life and the Sky Axe of Death are in the way."
God Emperor Evergreen, Lord Dongxu Star, and God King Gaizang took action again.
The Sky Ax of Death and the Tree of Life are once again attacking with all their strength. The power of the two top divine weapons is boundless. Every time they kill and entangle, they possess terrifying combat power comparable to that of the God King.
For a moment, the four god kings were restrained and could not get even half a step closer to Tianzun's ancient temple in a short period of time.
When the battle situation reached a stalemate, God King Wuyou took the opportunity to move and rushed towards Tianzun Ancient Palace like lightning.
The tree of life and the ax of death are being restrained by the four alien god kings. There is no doubt that this is a great opportunity to enter the ancient palace of Tianzun.
Uh-huh!
Silently, the figure of the Master of the Palace of Life and Death suddenly appeared, offering the Heavenly Lord's Wheel of Life and Death, pouring down with the power of suppressing the eternal cycle of reincarnation, accurately covering the Wuyou Divine King.
King Wuyou's expression suddenly changed: "Master of the Palace of Life and Death, how dare you taunt me?"
But it was too late.
The Master of the Palace of Life and Death is too fast, and he also holds ancient weapons such as the Tianzun Wheel of Life and Death, which can be said to be invincible at the same level.
A dull loud bang exploded.
Wuyou God King exploded again.
The Tianzun Wheel of Life and Death releases the unparalleled heavenly light of life and death. The Tai Chi Diagram of Life and Death is like a roulette wheel that wipes out all eternity. Every time it turns, it shatters a large number of souls of the Wuyou God King.
God King Wuyou is not strong enough, but he cannot be compared with the Master of Life and Death Hall. What's more, when he has mastered Tianzun's ancient weapons, the god is extremely afraid of him.
"Everyone, please save me, otherwise I will die and you and others will be defeated one by one!"
King Wuyou sent out a cry for help.
Under normal circumstances, it would be extremely difficult for even the Divine Lord to kill the Divine King, let alone the Divine King.
But the master of the Life and Death Palace revived ancient weapons such as the Heavenly Lord Life and Death Wheel with the same attribute, and it was not a problem at all to refine and kill the God King.
The four major clan god kings all changed their colors. Although they were very unhappy because Wuyou God King wanted to be the first to get there, they were still unhappy. After all, they could not just watch him being refined and killed by the Heavenly Lord's wheel of life and death.
As he said, once the Wuyou God King is refined and killed, they will be next.
Boom boom boom!
Immediately, the four major clan god kings gave up the collision with the two divine soldiers of life and death, and instead used the god king's magic to attack the master of the life and death hall and rescue the Wuyou god king.
At the very least, the Master of the Hall of Life and Death cannot be allowed to really kill the God King Wuyou, otherwise the consequences will be disastrous.
In desperation, the Master of the Life and Death Hall could only give up on continuing to refine and kill the Wuyou Divine King, and used the Heavenly Lord Life and Death Wheel to resist and neutralize the attack.
